column3: The presentation fits the time window. Six minutes goes quickly; practise it.
column9: Under 5 minutes or over 9, but a complete presentation.
column12: Under 3 minutes or over 11, or cut off before finishing.

column3: Spoken clearly to the room, organised, and able to answer a follow up question.
column6: Audible and clear, does not read from the slides, the talk has a shape, and a follow up question gets a real answer.
column9: Gets the content across, but reads from slides, is hard to hear, or stumbles on the follow up.
column12: Hard to follow, or cannot answer a question about work presented as their own.

column3: Ready to go when it is your turn. Slides submitted beforehand, links live, demo working.
column6: Slides submitted before presentation day and accessible, name and photo on them, project links open, and the live server comes up on request.
column9: Presents, but something was not ready: a dead link, slides found at the last minute, or the demo needed fixing.
column12: Significant setup time lost, or the live server could not be shown.
column15: Nothing submitted and nothing to present.
